name: jQuery-viewport-checker
description: Integrates the jQuery-viewport-checker library so CSS classes are added to elements as they scroll into the viewport, enabling scroll-triggered animations.
project_description:
jQuery-viewport-checker is a Drupal integration of jQuery-viewport-checker library . Little script that detects if an element is in the viewport and adds a class to it.

 This module allow you:

 
 download the libraries via drush command "drush vpc-dl" 
 switch js version (minimize or not) from drupal admin form 
 include or exclude pages where attach the library 
 
 Drupal 7 version dependencies 
 Libraries
